title: The Compass of Devil's Throat
author: Lena Ishikawa
blurb: Astrid Vasquez, a riverboat captain who knows every sandbar's mood, keeps moving because stopping costs more. Then a dying prospector trades a map for a promise — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, they must outlast the monsoon with a leaking boat and a stranger's help before the glacier calving season opens the route — briefly.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
